items.title: Trump raises prospect of 'big, beautiful' Russia-Ukraine deal
items.description: US President Donald Trump said the Ukraine war was close to being settled and that ending it might involve "all of Europe." Trump has previously made several similar promises, with no resolution to the conflict in sight.

items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
items.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

items.title: European shares join a global sell-off as AI spending fears rattle Wall Street and Asian markets
items.description: European shares have fallen after sharp losses in Asia and on Wall Street. Doubts over huge AI investments and fears of curbs following the Democrats' US midterm victory have rattled global markets.
